description: This Dart file defines the DashboardScreen widget for a Flutter application. It displays monthly expense statistics and charts including a weekly trend line chart and category pie chart, with UI components for date selection and data refresh, relying on the ReportsProvider for state management.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget representing the dashboard screen showing stats and charts.

classes.name: _HeaderBar
classes.description: Sub-widget providing the header with date selection and title.

classes.name: _StatsRow
classes.description: Sub-widget displaying key statistics like spent, remaining, and top category.

classes.name: _StatTile
classes.description: Reusable widget for individual statistic display with icon, label, and value.

classes.name: _TopCategoryTile
classes.description: Widget displaying top spending category details.

classes.name: _ChartsGrid
classes.description: Section containing weekly trend line chart and category pie chart.

classes.name: _SectionHeader
classes.description: Widget for section titles within the charts grid.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and triggers data load for the current month.

methods.name: _onMonthChanged
methods.description: Handles month change events by updating state and reloading data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the dashboard including refresh, header, stats, and charts.

methods.name: _monthLabel
methods.description: Helper to convert month number to abbreviated name.

methods.name: _formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a double value into a currency string.
